source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: The mine’s bearer can use it at the opening of your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), once per battle. Select one enemy unit the bearer can see at a distance of up to 9″. Roll a D6. A 3+ deals D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds). Roll twice that many dice against a **VEHICLE** (2D3).
